FlowerPainter.Sports.subtype.Tooltip: What kind of sports park this is. Presets set it with fitting facilities and landscape.
FlowerPainter.Sports.hero.Tooltip: The centrepiece: it takes the best spot with generous room around it, the spectator terrace and the clubhouse. Auto = the biggest field that is on.
FlowerPainter.Sports.spacing.Tooltip: Room between facilities, the tree belt and the paths. Distances also grow with the size of the park.
FlowerPainter.Sports.fieldAxis.Tooltip: Long fields run along the park's longest edge, or north–south / east–west (fewer players blinded by a low sun).
FlowerPainter.Sports.pitchSize.Tooltip: Pitch format. Auto picks the biggest that leaves room for everything else.
FlowerPainter.Sports.tennisCourtsCount.T: Fenced blocks of courts, set shoulder to shoulder.
FlowerPainter.Sports.tennisCourtsSize.To: Courts side by side in one fenced block.
FlowerPainter.Sports.changingHut.Tooltip: A changing pavilion with toilets behind the spectator terrace, next to the main field.
FlowerPainter.Sports.terrace.Tooltip: A paved terrace along the main field with a touchline walk and rows of benches.
FlowerPainter.Sports.kiosk.Tooltip: A refreshment kiosk beside the clubhouse.
FlowerPainter.Sports.promenade.Tooltip: A jogging loop inside the tree belt, a tree-lined spine from the entrance to the clubhouse, or both.
FlowerPainter.Sports.entrancePlaza.Toolt: A paved forecourt at the main entrance with bike racks, a noticeboard and bins.
FlowerPainter.Sports.bikeRacks.Tooltip: Bike racks on the entrance plaza.
FlowerPainter.Sports.treeBelt.Tooltip: Trees along the outline, outside the promenade loop.
FlowerPainter.Sports.treeDensity.Tooltip: Groves between the facilities: tree groups with open lawn between them.
FlowerPainter.Sports.berms.Tooltip: Low planted earth berms in the larger gaps between zones (permanent terrain change).
FlowerPainter.Sports.parking.Tooltip: A tidy car park on the street side next to the main entrance. Auto: only for parks of 2.5 ha or more with road frontage.
FlowerPainter.Sports.lotShare.Tooltip: Share of the park given to the car park.
FlowerPainter.Sports.tennisSurface.Toolt: What the tennis courts are laid in: hard courts, clay (a club look) or grass.
